problem.scope: Reuse a chat backend containing a version-pinned generation subsystem. Authored practice compares in-process and remote composition, compatibility adapters, explicit upgrades and per-instance overrides; timing values are illustrative.

acceptanceCases.given: Capacity instances A and B pin binding v1 inside one backend process; the default capacity is 4, A overrides it to 2, and the registry is at version 7.
acceptanceCases.then: Only A moves to v2 with capacity 8 and the registry reaches version 8; B keeps v1 and effective capacity 4; defaults, binding records and the prior state are unchanged; the stale retry, incompatible binding, invalid override and unknown instance are rejected.
acceptanceCases.when: Upgrade A to compatible binding v2 with capacity 8 at expectedVersion 7, retry the same request, then try an incompatible binding, capacity 0 and an unknown instance.

acceptanceCases.when: Stage 8 applies the operator's explicit upgrade.
